name: dsh-desktop
description: DeepSeek Harness 独立桌面端 —— 类似 Codex 的桌面 UI，托管 dsh web 后端，提供应用、后端与 Profile 三轨升级，DSH 本体零改动。
author: DSH Desktop Contributors

scripts.test:smoke: set DSH_DESKTOP_SMOKE=1&& set DSH_DESKTOP_DEBUG=1&& set DSH_DESKTOP_USER_DATA=%TEMP%\dsh-desktop-smoke&& electron .
scripts.test:smoke:fixture: set DSH_DESKTOP_SMOKE=1&& set DSH_DESKTOP_DEBUG=1&& set DSH_DESKTOP_USER_DATA=%TEMP%\dsh-desktop-smoke-fixture&& node scripts/init-smoke-settings.js&& electron .
scripts.test:package: set DSH_DESKTOP_BUILD_DIR=dist-test&& set DSH_DESKTOP_SKIP_SHORTCUT=1&& node scripts/build.js --dir&& node scripts/verify-build.js dist-test/win-unpacked
